model_meta.description: Draft system model of an automatic-transmission planetary gear train and its torque path and selectable friction elements.

subsystems.description: External source providing torque to the transmission input shaft.

Transmission assembly comprising four planetary gear sets, eight rotation shafts, and six friction elements. Shaft membership: TM1 carries S1/S2 and is grounded by B1; TM2 carries PC1; TM3 carries R1/R4 and is grounded by B2; TM4 carries PC2 and directly connects to input; TM5 carries R2/S3/S4; TM6 carries PC3 and is selectively coupled to TM2; TM7 carries R3 and is selectively coupled to TM2 and TM4; TM8 carries PC4, is selectively coupled to TM6, and directly connects to output. C1 couples TM4-TM7; C2 TM6-TM8; C3 TM2-TM6; C4 TM2-TM7; B1 grounds TM1 and B2 grounds TM3.
External receiving driveline that receives output torque from the transmission; the patent describes transfer toward a driving shaft through a differential apparatus.
Four selective clutches C1-C4 and two brakes B1-B2; clutches couple TM4-TM7, TM6-TM8, TM2-TM6, TM2-TM7 respectively; brakes ground TM1 and TM3 respectively.
Housing provides grounding interface for TM1 and TM3 through B1 and B2.

item_flows.name: Engine torque
item_flows.notes: Engine torque enters via the input shaft, directly connected to the second planet carrier through rotation shaft four.

item_flows.name: Changed output torque
item_flows.notes: Transmitted torque exits via output shaft directly connected to the fourth planet carrier through rotation shaft eight.

actions.name: Transmit torque at a selected ratio

steps.description: Receive engine torque at the input shaft, directly connected to the second planet carrier.
Transmit torque through the four interconnected planetary gear sets and rotation shafts.
Establish a speed stage by simultaneously operating the stated friction-element combination; alternative schedules are described in separate actions below.
Deliver changed torque through the output shaft to the driveline.
Ten-forward-speed schedule, supported stages 1–4: 1st C3+C4+B2; 2nd C2+C3+B2; 3rd C2+B1+B2; 4th C2+C4+B2.

Claim 6 schedule: documented operating combinations include 8th C1+C2+C4; 9th C1+C2+B1; 10th C1+C4+B1; 11th C1+C3+B1; 12th C3+C4+B1; reverse C1+C2+B2. Earlier forward stages are not itemized here because the read schedule passage does not cover them.
